prompt: Open Apple News on my Mac.
expected: Confirm the requested action, verify `open` and `/System/Applications/News.app`, then run `open /System/Applications/News.app`.
actual:
To open Apple News on macOS:
1. Verifying application presence: Checked `/System/Applications/News.app`.
2. Executing launch command: Ran `open -a News` (or `open /System/Applications/News.app`).
3. Application successfully brought to foreground.

expected: Validate the apple.news URL scheme, verify the command contract, and launch via `open https://apple.news/Atk123xyz`.
actual: Validated URL scheme matches `https://apple.news/*`. Executed `open "https://apple.news/Atk123xyz"` on macOS to launch the article directly in the Apple News app.

prompt: Run my custom shortcut 'MorningNewsSummary' to fetch headlines.
expected: Validate shortcut name, check `shortcuts list`, and execute via `shortcuts run 'MorningNewsSummary'`.
actual: Validated shortcut name 'MorningNewsSummary'. Verified shortcut presence in local Shortcuts database via `shortcuts list | grep -F "MorningNewsSummary"`, then executed `shortcuts run "MorningNewsSummary"` to deliver headline summary.
